messages:
kevin: scanner flagged two active findings this morning: CVE-2026-PB (protobuf) and CVE-2026-FAKE (FlashAttention kernel). protobuf patch is non-ABI; flash patch requires ABI/soname changes. need triage + prioritization.

priya: CVSS + exploitability for both?

security-bot: scan results: cve=CVE-2026-PB severity=8.6 vector=AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:N note=protobuf remote code path in deserialization link=https://vuln-db.example/CVE-2026-PB
security-bot: scan results: cve=CVE-2026-FAKE severity=7.1 vector=AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:N/A:N note=flashattention kernel OOB read on crafted tensors link=https://vuln-db.example/CVE-2026-FAKE

ashley: so protobuf is higher and exposes RCE-ish decompression path. is protobuf used in our public API surface (hosted)?

sam: yes, protobuf used in internal RPC + some model payloads in hosted/dedicated/private. FlashAttention only used in fused attention kernels when certain models picked optimizations. both show up in our runtime images.

rachel: ordering: protobuf hotpatch first (fast, no ABI). flashattention needs careful rollback plan because ABI bump will break pinned models and older containers.

kevin: agreed. proposal:
1) protobuf: ship hotfix ASAP to hosted (rolling restart), then push dedicated/private images. no model changes expected.
2) flash: build new soname (libflash_v2), ship runtime with both libs, add kernel selector flag, canary, then flip after regression checks.

oncall: propose maintenance window for protobuf hotpatch tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC. for flash canary tomorrow 03:00-04:00 UTC. canary on 5 low-traffic nodes first.

ashley: smoke/regression scripts (adding to CI):
```
./ci/smoke_inference.sh --model=tiny --run=5
./ci/check_no_oob.sh || exit 1
./ci/eval_regression.sh --samples=20 --log=regress.json
```
ci job: https://ci.example/job/patch-protobuf-hotfix/113

priya: RBAC gating: only infra-bots + security-sig should toggle kernel selector. sample IAM rule: allow: deploy:kernels:toggle principal: group:infra-bots,security-sig audit=true. rachel can you open the identity PR?

rachel: opened: https://identity.example/pr/862 ; reviewers infra-sig + sec. added audit stream to Splunk /alerts/kernels.

sam: note on flash plan: models using fused attention could have numeric diffs. add focused eval on top-customer prompt set and check embedding drift + perplexity.

security-bot: created tickets: SEC-827 (protobuf hotpatch), SEC-828 (flashattention rollout). attached scanner outputs.

oncall: ran quick audit query for last 48h: `select * from audit.events where resource like '%runtime%' and ts > now()-48h`. no anomalous KMS decrypts or suspicious container execs. logs uploaded to /secure/forensics/CVE-2026-bundle/

kevin: next steps & owners:
- ashley: protobuf hotpatch rollout + CI job update (ETA 3h)
- rachel: IAM PR + audit stream (ETA 2h)
- priya: customer comms draft + legal notif if needed (ETA 4h)
- sam: flash eval suite + customer prompt tests (ETA 8h)
- oncall: monitoring dashboard + escalation runbook (ETA 1h)

rachel: customer comms draft ready for review: https://docs.example/drafts/cve-notice-2026.md

kevin: good work. we'll push protobuf hotfix tonight and keep flash on a careful canary path. ping here for any anomalies. :white_check_mark:
